moments.text: Handheld phone video of black night sky, no ground or horizon in view. A small white light sits just below the centre.
As the camera shakes, the light reappears left of centre as a large, blurred glow, then drifts back toward the middle.
The light flares into two overexposed bars with a purple glow, then tightens into two bright points, one above the other.
It separates into a small cluster of three or four points, two stacked on the left, that shift around one another.
The light leaves the frame; only dark, empty sky shows for about 20 seconds.
A single bright light returns upper left of centre and slides down to near the bottom edge, where it holds until it drops out.
Near the bottom edge, the light shows as two bright points, one above the other, with a purple glow.
The light is out of frame for most of the next half-minute; it only grazes the bottom edge at 1:02-1:03.
The light comes back in from the right, smeared into streaks by camera shake, and settles near the centre.
Steadier view: a small point near the centre that, from 1:26, shows as two points, one above the other.
A second, fainter point is visible near the left edge, well up and to the left of the main light.
The picture cuts to black and stays black for the last 33 seconds.

notes: Light is off-frame for long stretches (7-27 s, 49-77 s). Final 33 s (2:09.7-2:42.75) is pure black.
